targets.guideTitle: How to add it (works with any provider)
guideSteps: Open your domain provider dashboard (Cloudflare, GoDaddy, Namecheap, Hostinger, Google Domains, etc.) and go to the DNS section.
Create a new record of type TXT.
In "Name" or "Host" paste the value below. Note: some providers append your domain automatically, so if it asks only for the subdomain use "_sentra-challenge".
In "Value" or "Content" paste the sentra-verify string. Leave TTL on automatic.
Save and come back here in 1–2 minutes to click Verify (DNS propagation is not instant).

sentraSecurity.title: How we protect Sentra
sentraSecurity.subtitle: We sell security, so we start with our own.
sentraSecurity.intro: Sentra is built following DevSecOps principles and industry standards. This page summarizes, without fluff, how we handle your data and secure the platform.

practices.title: Argon2id password hashing
practices.desc: We never store passwords in plaintext. We use Argon2id, the hashing algorithm recommended by OWASP, resistant to brute-force attacks with specialized hardware.

practices.title: Short-lived, rotating sessions
practices.desc: 15-minute access tokens and opaque refresh tokens with rotation and reuse detection: if one is stolen, the entire session family is revoked automatically.

practices.title: Role-based access control (RBAC)
practices.desc: Owner/Admin/Analyst/Member roles with permissions enforced on the server, not just hidden in the UI. Every sensitive action is recorded in an immutable audit log.

practices.title: Encryption in transit
practices.desc: All traffic travels over HTTPS/TLS. We apply security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options) to mitigate XSS, clickjacking and data leakage.

practices.title: Infrastructure isolation
practices.desc: Services run in isolated containers as a non-privileged user. The database is never exposed to the internet: only the application reaches it over an internal network.

practices.title: Passive, verified scans
practices.desc: We only audit domains you verify ownership of via DNS, and we never exploit vulnerabilities. We observe already-public information without generating load or risk on your systems.

practices.title: Cross-organization isolation
practices.desc: Every query is scoped to your organization at the database level (anti-IDOR protection): it's impossible to see or touch another account's data by changing an identifier.

practices.title: Secrets outside the code
practices.desc: Keys and credentials live in server environment variables, never in the repository. Card data never touches our servers: it's processed by Lemon Squeezy's checkout.

sentraSecurity.disclosureBody: Found a vulnerability in Sentra? We'd appreciate a private report before you make it public. We respond to all legitimate reports and credit anyone who wishes.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of Sentra ("the Service"), a security auditing and monitoring platform operated by Kevin Javier Montatixe Caiza. By creating an account or using the Service, you accept these Terms.

sections.heading: Service description
body: Sentra performs passive analysis of the security posture of domains you verify as your own, computes a score, generates reports and alerts you to changes. The Service observes public information (HTTP headers, TLS, DNS, certificate transparency) and does not run intrusive tests or exploit vulnerabilities.

sections.heading: Acceptable use and authorization
body: You may only audit domains you own or are explicitly authorized to audit, and you must complete DNS verification before scanning.

Using Sentra to audit third-party systems without permission, bypass their access controls, or for any illegal purpose is prohibited. You are responsible for your use of the Service and for the authorizations you claim to hold.

sections.heading: CV generator
body: The CV generator is an assistance tool: it tailors your resume to a job posting using artificial intelligence, based on the information you provide. It does NOT guarantee getting a job nor the absolute accuracy of the generated text — you are responsible for reviewing and correcting the CV before using it.

You may only enter personal data that is yours or that you are authorized to use. Do not upload third-party postings or data that infringe copyright or confidentiality. The generated content is for your personal use in recruitment processes.

sections.heading: Accounts and team
body: You must provide accurate information and keep your credentials confidential. You are responsible for your organization's activity, including members you invite and the roles you assign them.

sections.heading: Plans and payments
body: The free plan requires no payment. Paid plans are billed in advance and renew automatically until you cancel.
Payments are processed by Lemon Squeezy as Merchant of Record: they issue your invoice and handle applicable taxes. We do not store your card details.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
body: The Service, its code, brand and content belong to the operator. The reports and data you generate about your own domains are yours; we grant you a license to use the Service, not ownership of it.

sections.heading: Warranties and limitation of liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law, the operator is not liable for indirect damages, data loss or lost profits arising from use of or inability to use the Service.

sections.heading: Suspension and termination

sections.heading: Changes to the terms

sections.heading: Governing law and contact

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Policy explains what data Sentra collects, why, and how it protects it. We handle your data with the minimum necessary to operate the Service.

sections.heading: Data we collect
body: Account data: name, email, your organization name and password (stored only as an Argon2id hash, never in plaintext).
Usage data: domains you register, scan results, and technical metadata needed to provide the Service.
We do not collect card data: it is handled directly by Lemon Squeezy in its checkout.

sections.heading: How we use data
body: To operate your account, run scans, generate reports, send you security alerts and transactional emails (verification, invitations), and manage your subscription. We only send marketing communications with your explicit consent, which you can withdraw anytime.

sections.heading: Providers (subprocessors)
body: We rely on trusted third parties that process data on our behalf: Lemon Squeezy (payments and billing), Resend (email delivery), Groq (AI report generation), and Cloudflare together with our hosting provider (delivery and infrastructure). Each accesses only the data needed for its function.

sections.heading: Scan data
body: Scans analyze only publicly accessible information about domains you verified as your own. We do not access private content of your systems or store sensitive data hosted on them.

sections.heading: CV generator data
body: When you use the CV generator we process: your experience/CV text, the job posting text (that you paste or that we extract via OCR from an image you upload) and the generated CV. This data may include your personal information.

To generate the CV, that text is sent to Groq (our AI provider, with infrastructure in the United States): this is an international data transfer, performed solely to generate your CV. Images you upload are processed to extract their text and are NOT stored.

We store your generated CVs in your account so you can reuse and edit them (you chose to keep history). We keep them while your account is active or until YOU delete them: you can delete any CV at any time from the tool (right to erasure), and deletion is permanent.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: We use strictly necessary cookies to keep you securely signed in (httpOnly session cookie). We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Retention
body: We keep your data while your account is active. If you delete it, we erase or anonymize your personal data within a reasonable period, except what we must retain for legal or accounting obligations.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You can access, rectify, export or request deletion of your personal data, and object to certain processing, under applicable law (including GDPR and Ecuador's LOPDP). To exercise them, contact us.

sections.heading: Data security
body: We apply encryption in transit, strong password hashing, role-based access control, infrastructure isolation and audit logging. No system is infallible, but we handle your information with industry standards. See our Security page for details.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
body: We may update this Policy; material changes will be notified by reasonable means. For privacy questions, write to javiercaiza220158@gmail.com.
